title: Quick Grilled Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and festive Brazilian dish featuring coconut cream and dairy-free friendly ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner or outdoor gathering.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut cream, lime juice, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Cook the skewers in the air fryer for 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions.
Repeat with remaining chicken and marinade.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
